dedupe_keys.name: usda snap retailer locator data authorized snap retailers current and historical

description: This dataset lists stores authorised to accept Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits in the United States, which amounts to a national register of food retailers used by low-income households. The US Department of Agriculture's Food and Nutrition Service publishes it alongside its online retailer locator. The downloadable file gives each retailer's name, store type (supermarket, super store, grocery, convenience store, farmers market and others), address, latitude and longitude, and authorisation and end dates, and the historical file includes retailers that were authorised at any time, with data current as of 31 December 2025 at the latest check. Coverage is all states and territories that run SNAP. Data are free to download as a zipped CSV file, with further download options through the agency's open data tools, as a US government product. Caveats: the list contains only stores that accept SNAP, so some specialty and high-end grocers are absent, store type codes are broad, and store size or sales volume is not given. Simulation uses: mapping food retail access for food supply disruption and hazard exposure models, estimating which low-income neighbourhoods lose food access when stores close after floods or power cuts, and siting emergency food distribution. Related records: the USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas (data-usda-ers-food-access-research-atlas) measures access by census tract, and the New York State retail food stores list (data-nys-retail-food-stores) is a state-level counterpart.
